body.x: KOHLER unveiled a ‘Smart Mirror’ with voice recognition function at ‘CES 2018 Unveiled’ held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. on Sunday, Jan. 7th.

KOHLER is a famous company for making outstanding products. This company has been making design and craftsmanship real. Kohler’s products are available at all prices and provide consumers various options for kitchen and bath products. The smart mirror introduced at CES this year, is equipped with a microphone and a speaker to enable voice recognition and automatically lights up when user comes near the mirror. It is also possible to adjust the brightness of the light through voice and search for news, weather and traffic information.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
